Revised Edition of the Laws Act
Chapter 275, Section 11(3)
Order under Section 11(3)
O 15
G.N. No. S 250/1997
REVISED EDITION 1998
(15th June 1998)
[30th May 1997]
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have published in loose-leaf form the Acts set out in the Schedule as in force on 5th May 1997:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of each of the loose-leaf edition of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, with effect from 30th May 1997, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
(1) The Interpretation Act (Chapter 1).
(2) The Countervailing and Anti-Dumping Duties Act (Chapter 65B).
(3) The Executive Condominium Housing Scheme Act (Chapter 99A).
(4) The Goods and Services Tax Act (Chapter 117A).
(5) The Housing and Development Act (Chapter 129).
(6) The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore Act (Chapter 170A).
(7) The Miscellaneous Offences (Public Order and Nuisance) Act (Chapter 184).
(8) The Misuse of Drugs Act (Chapter 185).
(9) The National Parks Act (Chapter 198A).
(10) The Property Tax Act (Chapter 254).
(11) The Stamp Duties Act (Chapter 312).
(12) The Town Councils Act (Chapter 329A).
(13) The Transfer of Nanyang University Alumni Register Act (Chapter 333A).
(14) The Women’s Charter (Chapter 353).
[G.N. No.S 250/97]
